data.narrative:
Alto Neuroscience is a publicly traded biotech company currently valued at $1.04B, having raised $253M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of 5 companies in the Biotech & Health sector spanning similar valuation tiers, including both public names (Recursion Pharmaceuticals at $1.6B, Freenome at $1.1B) and late-stage private firms (Chai Discovery at $3.8B, New Limit at $3.1B, Eikon Therapeutics at $539M).

Peer-median analysis is the applicable triangulation method here. The median valuation across the five-company set stands at $1.6B, with a range spanning $539M to $3.8B. This method directly anchors valuation to same-sector comparables at comparable maturity stages. A revenue-based approach using public-market multiples (sector P/S median of 6.2x across 3 public biotech tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue data for the target.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $1.8B, centered on a median of $1.6B. Alto's current $1.04B valuation sits materially below this peer-anchored midpoint, a gap likely attributable to execution risk, clinical-stage asset timing, or market-specific factors. The primary uncertainty is peer comparability—the set includes both earlier-stage private companies and public-market names subject to different liquidity and regulatory regimes, creating width in the range. Revenue disclosure would enable multiples-based validation.
